Close to Eastern Lake

3 bikes!

Beach chairs and beach cart

4-star restaurants

A House With No Name by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 A House With No Name is a freshly renovated, three-bedroom, two-bath beach cottage in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Designed with modern coastal style and plenty of charm, it’s the kind of place that makes unwinding feel effortless. The bright and open living spaces feature stylish, comfortable furnishings with a clean, contemporary vibe. The fully stocked kitchen makes it easy to whip up a quick breakfast or a seafood feast to enjoy inside or out on the patio. Step into the backyard and find your own private getaway. A heated pool, lush greenery, and plenty of space to lounge make it easy to stay all day. Morning coffee by the pool, an afternoon swim, or cocktails under the stars, it’s all here. For beach days, two nearby access points make hitting the sand a breeze.

San Roy Road and Sugar Dunes Beach Access are both within easy reach. San Roy offers a quieter stretch of shoreline, while Sugar Dunes is great for sunset views, with bike racks and showers for convenience. The Eastern Lake boat launch is just around the corner, and kayak rentals are close if you're ready to explore. Seagrove’s best restaurants, shops, and cafes are just a short walk or ride away, because good food and fun are part of the vacation too. Oversee 30A is local and family-owned. Our team is passionate about keeping homes clean and making sure your stay runs smoothly. We’re available seven days a week and have a 24/7 emergency line. Need something? We’re nearby and ready to help. Overview: - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Dog friendly, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog - 400 steps (.2 mi) to the beach (Sugar Dunes Access) - 3 bedrooms, 2 baths - 1376 sq ft - Wi-Fi - Beach chairs and cart - Gas grill - 3 bikes included Overnight: GROUND LEVEL - Primary Suite: King bed, en-suite bath, TV - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared hall bath - Guest Room: Two twins, shared hall bath - Queen sleeper sofa in living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
